design.gain: gain_A_over_B = log_loss_B - log_loss_A; positive favors A
design.phases: np.array_split chronological retained indices into three near-equal counts
design.calibration: favored-option confidence, .50:.05:1.00 bins; .5 favors left; last bin closed
design.reward_categories: equal=0, small=1 supplied reward unit, larger>1; never fabricate absent categories
design.equal_pair_probes: counterfactual state contrasts only; no simulated action, update, or observed preference
design.fixed_parameter_memory: S1-S4-fitted parameters replay S1-S5; S1-S4 portions descriptive, not held out
design.final_test: RData container deserialized; final-test object never accessed by pipeline; phase and session guards
